Zofia Obradovic is the chief financial officer at [Rookley Labs](companies/rookley-labs), a role Zofia has held since December 2022. Before that, Zofia was procurement manager at [Garion Hardware](accounts/garion-hardware).

## Career

- Since December 2022: chief financial officer, [Rookley Labs](companies/rookley-labs)
- May 2019 to November 2022: procurement manager, [Garion Hardware](accounts/garion-hardware)

## Background

Friends know Zofia for long walks and longer opinions about coffee. Zofia reads every customer complaint that mentions a missed delivery. Zofia tends to bring a printed agenda and to stick to it. Most weeks Zofia blocks a morning for deep work and declines meetings then.

## Timeline

- **2022-12-01** | Started as chief financial officer at [Rookley Labs](companies/rookley-labs)
- **2019-05-01** | Started as procurement manager at [Garion Hardware](accounts/garion-hardware)

Early on, Zofia worked in public sector procurement, which still shapes how deals get structured.

A former colleague called Zofia the calmest person in any escalation.

Zofia is careful with commitments and writes down what was agreed.

People who work with Zofia say the follow-up notes arrive the same afternoon.

Zofia is direct about trade-offs and rarely promises dates without a buffer.

Zofia studied history at Westmarch Institute before moving into industry.

Colleagues describe Zofia as patient in negotiations and quick with a spreadsheet.

When a project slips, Zofia asks for the smallest next step rather than a new plan.

Zofia grew up near Bilbao and still goes back for the long summer weekends.

Zofia prefers short written updates to long status meetings.

Zofia mentors two junior colleagues and runs an informal reading group.
